title: Middle-layer Fourier polynomial coefficient
statement: Let $m,k\ge 0$, and let $T$ be a subset of the $2m$ coordinates with $|T|=k$. The coefficient of $t^k$ in $\sum_{U\subseteq\{1,\ldots,2m\}}\widehat{f}(U)t^{|U|}$ is $\binom{2m}{k}\widehat{f}(T)$, where $f$ is the indicator of sign vectors having exactly $m$ positive coordinates and $\widehat{f}(U)$ is its Fourier coefficient at $U$.
hypotheses_covered: A subset T of the 2m coordinates
The cardinality of T equals k
